subject: [VolPred Alert][WARN] P8 volatility-absorption — CRITICAL errata identified: Harvey-threshold crossing + sign flip
body:
Alert level: warn
Title: P8 volatility-absorption — CRITICAL errata identified: Harvey-threshold crossing + sign flip

## 觸發條件
P8 K903/K904 snapshot rerun (2026-04-19 Codex task_4e75) 揭示 2 個嚴重 paper claim 問題：

1. **CRITICAL — Harvey-threshold crossing**:
   - Paper controlled regression t = -3.14 (declared Harvey-significant)
   - Snapshot rerun t = -1.17 (FAILS Harvey |t|>3)
   - Paper's '控制後仍顯著' 主張 under current yfinance snapshot 不成立

2. **HIGH — T10 2020-2026 β sign flip**:
   - Paper β = -0.00035 (absorption)
   - Snapshot β = +0.000139 (inversion)
   - Paper's 'absorption all periods' claim breaks for COVID/inflation era

其他 10+ MEDIUM magnitude drifts (T9 tau-robustness, T10 sub-periods) 在 reasonable range 內。

shelf-ready errata: paper/volatility-absorption/errata_pending.md (剛建).

## 影響
- Mission 3 (論文寫好): P8 現在 R1 review state, 需 decision 決定 revision 路徑
- 不能當 'submission-ready' 直到 sign flip + Harvey boundary 處理完
- 跟 P9 garch-x-vix 不同 — P9 是 submitted under review, 可 shelf errata 待 R1 response。P8 尚未投稿, 必須 body 修正或決策再提
- P8 reproduce gate 61.3% AMBER 暫時無法升 GREEN 直到 body 決策執行

## 建議行動
請 review errata_pending.md 選 Path：
- **Path A**: 嘗試 pull yfinance archive 恢復 paper drafting-time snapshot (可能無法 time-travel)
- **Path B** (推薦 research-honest): 接受 current snapshot canonical, 修 body T10 + 加 crisis-era caveat, 調整 'absorption all periods' claim
- **Path C**: Dual-report + prominent errata section 作 fall-back

同時 review controlled-regression 是否有 alternative spec 讓 Harvey 仍 pass (例如 different covariate set / time window)。

下個 session 可把 decision 轉成 sub-task 派主線程或 agent。
